boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Sacramento State rituals spanning new-student pinning, Hornet spirit, Homecoming, the UC Davis rivalry, service, and annual campus celebrations.

cards.title: Get Pinned Into the Hornet Family
cards.subtitle: New Student and Family Convocation
cards.notes: Bring a supporter to Convocation and exchange the commemorative Hornet pin that marks the formal start of your Sac State journey.
cards.short_summary: A supporter pins each new student during the University’s official welcome ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State calls Convocation an official induction and says its Hornet Pinning Ceremony has students and supporters exchange commemorative pins as a symbol of belonging.
cards.access_notes: Offered during spring and fall Convocation; registration and ceremony-specific arrival instructions may apply.

cards.title: Turn a Golf Cart Into Homecoming Art
cards.subtitle: Annual decorated-cart competition and stadium lap
cards.notes: Join through a campus organization or department, follow the decorating rules, and submit every driver-authorization document by the deadline.
cards.short_summary: Campus groups decorate golf carts, enter judging, join Hornet Walk, and circle the stadium.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State identifies the Golf Cart Parade as an annual Homecoming event whose entrants join Hornet Walk and display their decorated carts in Hornet Stadium.
cards.access_notes: Participation requires advance registration and completed driver-authorization materials; consult the current Homecoming page for dates.

cards.title: Raise a Stinger for Hornet Walk
cards.subtitle: The team’s pregame procession toward Hornet Stadium
cards.notes: Stand along the announced route before kickoff and cheer as the football team, band, and spirit groups make their way toward the stadium.
cards.short_summary: Fans greet the Hornets and campus performers during their ritual walk into game day.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State describes Hornet Walk as a ritual in which fans yell “Stingers up!” while football players, the marching band, and cheerleaders head toward Hornet Stadium.
cards.source_title: Task force looks for best pregame party practices
cards.access_notes: Timing varies by game; use the current athletics or Homecoming schedule and remain on designated spectator routes.

cards.title: Settle the Causeway Rivalry
cards.subtitle: Sacramento State’s annual football game against UC Davis
cards.notes: Check which campus hosts that season, wear green and gold, and use the official athletics listing for kickoff, tickets, and venue policies.
cards.short_summary: The Hornets and Aggies renew a regional football rivalry that began in 1954.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State documents the Causeway Classic as an annual football rivalry with UC Davis and states that the series dates to 1954.
cards.source_title: Combat U’s boxing team will go head-to-head with UC Davis in the ring as Sacramento State expands Causeway Classic
cards.access_notes: The host venue, kickoff time, ticket rules, and entry policies change by season; verify them through official athletics listings.

cards.title: Give Blood Before the Rivalry
cards.subtitle: An annual service tradition tied to Causeway season
cards.notes: Review donor eligibility, reserve a time with the announced blood-services partner, and bring the identification requested at check-in.
cards.short_summary: The Causeway rivalry becomes a recurring campus blood-donation campaign.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State identifies the Causeway Classic Blood Drive as an annual campus blood drive conducted with Vitalant.
cards.access_notes: Donation depends on current medical eligibility and appointment availability; follow the organizer’s screening and identification requirements.

cards.title: Answer With Stingers Up
cards.subtitle: Sacramento State’s familiar Hornet hand sign and rallying phrase
cards.notes: Use the familiar hand gesture in campus photos or pair the phrase with a cheer when official events invite the Hornet community to respond.
cards.short_summary: A hand sign and two-word call punctuate Sac State celebrations and athletics.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State describes “Stingers Up” as a familiar gesture and documents it as part of the University’s sports-fan tradition.
cards.source_title: Commitment to Latino students earns national certification
cards.access_notes: No special access is required; participate respectfully when the gesture or rallying phrase is invited at campus events.

cards.title: Watch the Union Change Overnight
cards.subtitle: The University Union’s themed fall showcase
cards.notes: Visit during the second week of fall classes to see the annual theme and explore the Union’s participating offices, services, and vendors.
cards.short_summary: An overnight transformation turns the University Union into a themed campus showcase.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State says Phlagleblast was established in 2000 and is held annually during the second week of fall, with the University Union decorated overnight around a selected theme.
cards.access_notes: The weekday and theme vary by year; consult the current Weeks of Welcome calendar before visiting the University Union.

cards.title: Fit Into the Annual Hornet Photo
cards.subtitle: Swarm Day gathering with Herky in the Library Quad
cards.notes: Arrive in the Library Quad before the announced photo time, find the gathering near the fountain, and follow staff directions for the group shot.
cards.short_summary: Hornets assemble with Herky for one enormous annual campus portrait.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State’s Swarm Day page directs attendees to gather in the Library Quad for the annual campus photo with Herky and the University president.
cards.access_notes: The photo occurs at a specific announced time during Swarm Day; check the current page for the date and gathering time.

cards.title: Start Homecoming With Herky
cards.subtitle: The mascot-centered opening theme of Spirit Week
cards.notes: Find a Herky figure or image, take a school-spirit photo, and follow the current Homecoming instructions if you want to submit or share it.
cards.short_summary: Homecoming week opens by putting Sacramento State’s mascot in the frame.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State’s official Homecoming schedule designates Monday as Herky Day and invites Hornets to begin the week with a Herky or Stingers Up selfie.
cards.access_notes: Herky Day is tied to the annual Homecoming calendar; confirm the current date and any submission instructions before participating.

cards.title: Wear the Campus Colors Everywhere
cards.subtitle: Friday of Sacramento State Homecoming Spirit Week
cards.notes: Wear Sacramento State green and gold on the scheduled Friday, whether you are on campus or away, and join official sharing prompts if desired.
cards.short_summary: Hornets close the workweek by dressing in Sacramento State’s colors.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacramento State’s official Homecoming schedule names Friday Green & Gold Spirit Day and invites the campus community and alumni to wear green-and-gold gear.
cards.access_notes: The observance follows the annual Homecoming schedule; verify the current Spirit Week date on the official page.
